Two sizes, the same complete story

Launch offer, 20% off both sizes. A5 portrait (14.8 × 21 cm), £49.99 £39.99. A4 portrait (21 × 29.7 cm), £59.99 £47.99. Both include a matte hardback, full-colour 200gsm glossy pages, 26 inside pages, a digital PDF and UK standard delivery. The front and back covers are additional to the inside pages.

Free preview, then a finished proof

Write and edit the story, check the character preview and choose a size. Save your book with your email and UK delivery address. Continue to secure payment when you are ready. Saving alone does not charge you.

Payment is made securely through Ziina. We prepare the full illustrated proof after payment. Check every page and approve that exact file. Our team then checks it before releasing it to Prodigi for printing. An order is never automatically released by payment.

Timing

UK delivery is estimated at 7–12 working days after final proof approval. This includes our final check, printing and standard shipping. Proof preparation happens before this window; we will confirm the expected preparation time when accepting your paid order. This is not a guaranteed arrival date. Corrections, public holidays, printer or courier delays can add time. Contact us before buying for a deadline.

Corrections and problems

Contact cravenluke@gmail.com with your order reference before approving if anything needs changing. After print release, changes may no longer be possible. If a book arrives damaged or incorrectly printed, contact us with photos so we can investigate a replacement or refund. Your statutory rights are unaffected.

Secure checkout, careful printing

Checkout is open. We will not charge a saved book automatically. After payment, you approve the completed proof and our team reviews and manually releases it to the printer.
